title: Power Automate process mining: export object-centric models to a Microsoft Fabric semantic model
summary: The export controls, optional wizard step, roadmap details and platform licensing are supported. However, the risk rationale still says Microsoft has not described who can read the published model, despite the cited permission reference documenting access inherited from workspace roles; that uncertainty must be narrowed to export-specific permission grants.
